subject: aftd
title: AF.TD.------MT.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 113 (ALT(FT)II-7). AFTD (affinity tendencies) is the subject; MT-INFO (multi-information) is the partner. The title names AF-TD (affinity tendencies); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: SPT-D (spectacle diversion), ATTN (attraction) and P-FC (particular focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SPT-D: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ATTN: VT-PLT (vibrational platform) and PRI-INFO (principle information). From P-FC: PER-DY (perception dynamics). From VT-PLT: T-L (time lag). From PRI-INFO: UTZ (utilization), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From PER-DY: MT-INFO.
